# pebble

```go
import "github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/stores/pebble"
```

Package pebble is the Pebble state\-store backend for blkit: a durable, embedded store keeping each run's ProcessState in local files, with balanced read\-and\-write performance. It shares the Badger backend's key scheme. See specs/stores/pebble\-state\-store.spec.md.

<a name="Store"></a>
## type [Store](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/pebble/store.go#L26-L31>)

Store implements bl.StateStore on a Pebble store. Write batches are serialised by a store\-level mutex so the persisted arrival counter can never regress; reads are lock\-free.

```go
type Store struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="New"></a>
### func [New](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/pebble/store.go#L40>)

```go
func New(cfg Config) *Store
```

New opens (creating if needed) the Pebble store and seeds the arrival counter from its persisted value. Following the blkit constructor convention it panics on an invalid config or an unopenable store.

<a name="Store.CurrentVersion"></a>
### func (\*Store) [CurrentVersion](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/pebble/store.go#L302>)

```go
func (s *Store) CurrentVersion(runID string) (*bl.CurrentVersion, error)
```

CurrentVersion folds the run's value records into the latest committed value per (task, field); iteration order is replay order. Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.Flush"></a>
### func (\*Store) [Flush](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/pebble/store.go#L258>)

```go
func (s *Store) Flush(runID string) error
```

Flush applies an empty batch carrying a LogData marker with Sync — the standard Pebble WAL sync barrier: when it returns, every previously applied batch is durable.

<a name="Store.FullHistory"></a>
### func (\*Store) [FullHistory](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/pebble/store.go#L338>)

```go
func (s *Store) FullHistory(runID string) (*bl.FullHistory, error)
```

FullHistory iterates the v| and h| prefixes in key (= replay) order. Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.WriteBatch"></a>
### func (\*Store) [WriteBatch](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/pebble/store.go#L134>)

```go
func (s *Store) WriteBatch(ops []bl.WriteOp) error
```

WriteBatch applies the ops as one pebble.Batch (atomic on apply), written with NoSync for throughput — Flush provides the durability barrier.
